messages:
eng-release-bot: Weekly release train bulletin: applying a short release freeze this week for a critical security patch. Freeze window: Thu 00:00 UTC -> Thu 06:00 UTC. Affected lanes: hosted prod + Dedicated. Staging remains open for non-model bumps. Docs: https://intranet.redwood.ai/releases/patch-2026-03-25
sam: Quick q — does this block scheduled model rollouts or just infra patches?
maria: Infrastructure + kernel-level quant fix only. Model version rollouts are blocked on prod during the freeze; you can still iterate on staging.
sam: Got it, thanks. Any canary concerns we should watch for?
prashant: Canary saw a small throughput regression on v3-3-quant during a synthetic spike earlier (~2.8% p99 increase). We're pushing a micro-hotfix to the inference kernel before prod. If p99 >3% during canary, we'll hold rollout.
lina: ETA on the hotfix?
prashant: Targeting Thu 02:30 UTC for canary patch; fallback plan is revert to v3-2 route mapping if not resolved by 03:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: security-patch-2026-03-25 at 02:00 UTC. Canary start at 02:05 UTC. Notifying on-call.
maria: Ops note: please cancel or pause non-critical deploys that touch serving during the window. Also update release runbooks and add a short briefing for customer-facing teams. :warning:
sam: I'll pause my feature branch merges into main until the freeze lifts.
prashant: Also temporarily relaxing cost-alert thresholds to reduce noise during the patch rollout. Will reapply normal thresholds after 07:00 UTC.
maria: @eng-oncall please monitor canaries and post status updates here every 15m during the window.
eng-oncall: ack — dashboards and traces are live. I will post brief updates.
eng-oncall: 02:10 UTC — canary healthy, no error-rate spikes in the last 5m.
prashant: 02:42 UTC — patch applied to canary, p99 latency back to baseline; beginning gradual traffic promotion to prod.
eng-oncall: 03:15 UTC — prod rollout at 30% traffic, error rate and tails stable. No elevated CPU on GPU hosts.
sam: heads-up for teams with scheduled jobs: delayed background batch runs until 07:00 UTC to avoid transient effects.
maria: if we see any user-facing impact we will follow rollback playbook: /playbooks/release-rollback — otherwise aim to lift freeze at 06:00 UTC.
prashant: 03:45 UTC — prod rollout reached 100% traffic, monitoring green.
eng-oncall: 04:00 UTC — continuous monitoring shows stable p50/p95/p99. No alerts.
maria: Thanks everyone. Please add a one-paragraph summary of what changed to the weekly release notes and flag any follow-ups for the postmortem board.
eng-release-bot: Summary: freeze applied Thu 00:00-06:00 UTC for security-patch-2026-03-25; canary passed; prod rollout completed by 03:45 UTC; no customer-impacting incidents. Thread closed.
